#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int n;
    string a;
    cin >> n >> a;

    bool inside = false;
    int best = 0;
    int words = 0;
    int len = 0;
    int i = 0;

    while (i < n) {
        char c = a[i];
        switch (c) {
            case '_':
                if (inside && len != 0) {
                    words++;
                } else {
                    if (len > best) best = len;
                }
                len = 0;
                break;
            case '(':
                inside = true;
                if (len > best) best = len;
                len = 0;
                break;
            case ')':
                inside = false;
                if (len > 0) {
                    words++;
                }
                len = 0;
                break;
            default:
                len++;
        }
        i++;
    }

    if (len > best) best = len;
    cout << best << " " << words << endl;

    return 0;
}
